installedAddons.name: Tips and Tricks

methodology: Isolated synthetic database; authenticated manual regression requests through actual ZAP proxy plus passive scanning of visited HTML, assets, and API responses. No unrestricted active scan, external service testing, Google login, or password-reset email delivery. Reset fixture seeded directly. No real customer data used.

results.name: PII disclosure through removed card API
results.evidence: GET 404; POST 404; no card data returned

results.name: Client-controlled order price and total
results.evidence: Submitted 0.01; server itemsPrice=100; totalPrice=125

results.name: Cross-user order disclosure
results.evidence: Unrelated customer 404; owner 200

results.name: Cross-user payment modification
results.evidence: Unrelated customer 403; isPaid remains false

results.name: Full card number and CVV persisted/returned
results.evidence: Removed API rejects reads/writes; isolated database cards collection has zero records. Existing installation was checked separately.

results.name: Payment marked paid without provider verification
results.evidence: Even administrator receives 400 for PayPal; isPaid remains false. Online payment disabled.

results.name: Customer changes another order delivery
results.evidence: Customer 403; isDelivered remains false

results.name: Password reset token reuse
results.evidence: First reset 200; reuse 400; old access token 401

results.name: Password-reset JWT accepted as access token
results.evidence: Legacy reset-shaped JWT on protected order API: 401

results.name: Prescription disclosure to unrelated customer
results.evidence: Customer 403; administrator 200

results.name: Prescription modification by unrelated customer
results.evidence: Customer 403; prescription unchanged

results.name: Missing Content Security Policy
results.evidence: CSP present on home/sign-in/sign-up. Inline styles intentionally permitted for current UI; scanner warnings are reported separately.

results.name: Missing anti-clickjacking header
results.evidence: X-Frame-Options DENY and CSP frame-ancestors none on all three HTML routes

results.name: Missing Subresource Integrity
results.evidence: Pinned Font Awesome CSS has verified SHA-384 integrity and crossorigin=anonymous

results.name: Cross-user support ticket response injection
results.evidence: Owner 201; unrelated customer 404; only owner response persisted

results.name: Single-character registration password
results.evidence: Registration 400; no user created

results.name: Application error disclosure
results.evidence: Authenticated malformed order ID: 400; generic Invalid request response

results.name: X-Powered-By framework disclosure
results.evidence: X-Powered-By absent on home/sign-in/sign-up

results.name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
results.evidence: nosniff present on home/sign-in/sign-up

results.name: Internal database details in order errors
results.evidence: Authenticated malformed ID returns HTTP 400 with no internal database detail

results.name: Modern Web Application
results.evidence: React SPA identification; no remediation required

cleanup: Isolated synthetic test database dropped after retest
